title: Autonym’s “Keep Me Running” serves as a testament to the struggles of growing up
htmlContent:
Autonym's latest single, "Keep Me Running," is simple yet powerful, capturing the quiet strength of personal growth and the passage of time. It speaks to anyone who has ever felt stuck between who they once were and who they are becoming.

The way the song is put together is thoughtful, with every note having purpose and each pause packed with meaning. Autonym expresses the feeling of pushing through difficult times, making it something we can all connect with. The message of the song is something everyone can understand, both the pressure to change and the challenge to keep going when life feels overwhelming.

https://open.spotify.com/track/6JhVz6BX04S44dOGK7JeWg?si=clFV2zogQgWGpB9PiNNcJA

"Keep Me Running" becomes a gentle song for those trying to persevere. Autonym has created something truly special. "Keep Me Running" feels understated yet impactful. It's like a soft voice in the dark, offering comfort and reassurance that even when life gets tough, we are stronger than we realize.
